source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Causes of Network Delay' (PDF 19): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network delay (deri) kai wajuhat se hoti hai. Bohat zyada users network ko slow kar sakte hain. Poor-quality (ghatiya) cables delay paida kar sakti hain. Devices ke darmiyan lamba faasla delay barhata hai. Network congestion (network par traffic ka rash, jaise sarak par jam) data ki speed par asar dalta hai. Hardware problems (kharab router, cable ya card) bhi network delay paida karte hain.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Diye gaye manzar (scenario) mein deri ki mumkina wajuhat pehchanein.

blocks.prompt: Raat 9 baje ghar ka internet bohat slow ho jata hai jab saare ghar wale videos dekhte hain. Kitab ki kaun si wajah lagti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada users aur network congestion: ek hi connection par bohat se log ek saath data le rahe hain.

items: Deri ki wajuhat: zyada users, ghatiya cables, lamba faasla, network congestion, hardware ke masail.
